label: ladder rung 6 network, transposition table keyed on the real side to move
elo_note: Direct Stockfish calibration, 30 games per level at depth 5, after fixing the transposition table that keyed every node on the root's side to move. Two runs: the first weighted 2188 (SF 2200, score 0.48) and 2412 (SF 2400, score 0.50); the second reported 2307 overall, with 2223 at SF 2200 (score 0.53) and 2412 at SF 2400 (score 0.52). The same instrument read 2033 immediately before the fix, so +274 is well outside its own +/- 130 spread across repeats. Margin here is that instrument spread, not a within-run interval. The previous 2127 came from adding a head-to-head +86 to a 2041 calibration; both of those were measured through the broken table and are superseded.
